{ "rules": [
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (1.00), forecast prices are too low - increase by ~3-5% to match true outcomes which show stronger sentiment-driven buying",
    "When sentiment turns negative (-0.33 to 0.00), model underforecasts the decline - prices drop ~2-4% more than modeled",
    "Model shows mean reversion bias when prices are at extremes - true outcomes extend further than model's calculated reversion to mean",
    "Sentiment turning from positive to mixed/neutral requires accelerating forecast deceleration that model doesn't capture",
    "When sentiment has been consistently positive for multiple days, model lags behind true price momentum - forecasts are 2-3 days behind reality",
    "Model overshoots corrections when sentiment is still mildly positive - true prices resist the depth of model's predicted declines",
    "Sentiment-based adjustments in model should be nonlinear - 1.00 sentiment requires 3-5% adjustment while 0.67 only needs 1-2%" ]
}
